Ritika (CS): Quick heads-up 10am cohort for Orchard preview is at 23 signups; standard capacity is 20. Need triage so high-risk accounts don't hit the waitlist. signup sheet: https://tiny.redwood/orchard-apr-signups
Calvin (AE): Which accounts are highest priority? I have two expansion deals that would be touchy if delayed.
Ritika (CS): Flagged: Pangea (renewal Q2), HelixPay (SAML + connector), LumenAI (security review). I added priority tags on the sheet.
Noor (PM): We should enable a "mini-track": core walkthrough (30m) + optional integration office hour (30m). That lets us fit more live seats. Also add "cohort_id" and "enablement_track" to the post-session micro-survey so we can split metrics. Survey template: https://tiny.redwood/micro-v2
Diego (SE): I can cover office hours for HelixPay Wed 3pm. If we split sessions we'll need invites marked "integration-required" so SEs know.
Oncall-bot: Notice: cohort_size >20 triggers waitlist. Current cohort=23. Suggested: tag high_priority to avoid waitlist automation.
Calvin (AE): I'll ask Pangea if recorded + guaranteed 1:1 is acceptable, otherwise we need to prioritize their live seat.
Ritika (CS): Action items: [Calvin] confirm Pangea preference (ASAP), [Diego] reserve Wed 3pm office hour (done), [Noor] add survey fields + follow-up rule (pending).
Noor (PM): Added fields: cohort_id=orchard_apr_01, enablement_track=mini|standard|recorded. Also set followup_needed=true for score<=2 to ping CS ops.
Calvin (AE): Pangea accepts recorded + 1:1. Freed 1 live seat.
Ritika (CS): Ok ive up 2 live seats by converting two attendees to recorded+office-hour. Updated sheet and CRM tags. Will post a short recap in morning.
Noor (PM): We'll also log enablement_track in analytics so we can compare time-to-first-success between tracks.
Ritika (CS): Thanks team. Keeping this tight to avoid churn risk.
